title: Turbulent mixed convection in a differentially heated vertical channel

reference.citation: Wagner & Wetzel (2022), Coherent structures in turbulent mixed convection flows through channels with differentially heated walls, GAMM-Mitteilungen 45, e202200006, DOI 10.1002/gamm.202200006
reference.data_policy: Use published DNS tables/profiles and any author-hosted numerical dataset. Pin exact data release and SHA-256 before comparing.

physics.model: Incompressible Boussinesq DNS; vertical plane channel; heated wall and cooled wall; periodic axial and spanwise directions; no-slip, impermeable walls.

dimensionless.richardson_definition: Ri = Gr/Re_b^2 using the same delta, bulk velocity and reference properties as the DNS.
dimensionless.warning: Do not compare Richardson numbers defined with different length scales or velocity scales.

reference_targets.wall_shear_stress_normalization: Dimensionless tau_w/(rho*Ub^2), as used by the DNS nondimensionalization; do not compare to dimensional Pa without restoring rho and Ub.

primary: mean axial velocity profile on heated and cooled halves
wall shear stress on each wall
Nusselt number and global heat balance
TKE budget terms if CFDX resolves/exports them
expected_trends: As Gr increases, aiding buoyancy accelerates mean flow near heated wall and opposing buoyancy decelerates it near cooled wall.
Mean wall shear stress increases on heated/aiding side and decreases on cooled/opposing side relative to isothermal baseline.
Reynolds shear stress is attenuated on aiding side and enhanced on opposing side.
Temperature and RMS-temperature profiles become asymmetric; compare the published profiles rather than imposing a guessed scalar target.

statistics.reference_equilibration: DNS statistics start after 50 u_tau/delta dimensionless time units following heating/cooling switch-on.
statistics.reference_averaging: At least 60 u_tau/delta dimensionless time units after statistical equilibrium.
statistics.mesh_resolution: Reference grid widths and time steps are listed in reference_targets.grid_reference; CFDX must document its own resolution and demonstrate mesh/time-step sensitivity.

status.reason: A RANS model can compare mean profiles and integral quantities only; RMS, Reynolds stress and heat-flux claims require a resolved unsteady model or an explicit Reynolds-stress/heat-flux closure.
